description: Built as an F-86D in the FY53 53-0570/53-1071 block and later converted to F-86L standard; the serial checks out; on loan from the National Museum of the USAF - the 2016 NMUSAF Aircraft on Loan by Location list carries it as F-86L 53-0665 to VFW POST 7714 IMPERIAL PA; displayed at 7977 Steubenville Pike in North Fayette Township. Presence confirmed in current aerial imagery.
